title: Modern Train Sounds For Create
description: A modern high-tech train audio overhaul for the Create mod. Replaces outdated steam sounds with clean, loud mechanical travel rhythms and silent stations.
body:
Modern Train Sounds For Create completely overhauls the acoustic atmosphere of trains in the Create mod. This project eliminates the outdated, low-quality steam locomotive sounds and replaces them with clean, heavy, high-tech train travel audio.


you can watch my channel [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@A-114_ze_splitter_entity)

### Key Features of the 0.7.0 Alpha:
* **Enhanced Audio Layers:** The driving wheels use optimized, high-volume audio tracks working in parallel to deliver a punchy and clear mechanical rhythm at full speed and during braking.
* **Station Quietness:** All idle and standing sounds have been muted to ensure modern trains stand in premium, silent comfort when stopped at stations.
* **Flawless Integration:** Built specifically for Create 0.5.1.j on Forge 1.20.1 to avoid common core integration crashes.

*Developed by A-114_ze_splitter_entity.*
